# nomadpack_registry (Resource)

Ensures a nomad-pack pack registry is present, at a pinned ref, in nomad-pack's cache on the machine running Terraform (`nomad-pack registry add`). Reference its `name` and `ref` from a `nomadpack_deployment` so the registry exists before the deployment runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adds the registry to nomad-pack's cache on the machine running Terraform
# (`nomad-pack registry add homelab <source> --ref=v1.2.3`).
resource "nomadpack_registry" "homelab" {
  name   = "homelab"
  source = "github.com/byteford/nomad-packs"
  ref    = "v1.2.3" # tag or commit SHA; empty and "latest" are rejected
}

# Reference the registry's attributes from the deployment so Terraform
# creates the registry first, and so the deployment moves to a new ref in
# the same apply as the registry.
resource "nomadpack_deployment" "mosquitto" {
  pack     = "mosquitto"
  registry = nomadpack_registry.homelab.name
  ref      = nomadpack_registry.homelab.ref
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name the registry is added under; this is the value a `nomadpack_deployment` sets as `registry`. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` only, starting with a letter or digit (nomad-pack uses it as a directory name). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `ref` (String) Git tag or commit SHA to add (`--ref`). Required, and must not be empty or `latest`/`@latest`: without a pinned ref nomad-pack overwrites its cached `@latest`. Use a tag or SHA, not a branch, so applies are reproducible. Changing it adds the new ref in place and leaves the old ref cached, so deployments still pinned to it keep working.
- `source` (String) Git URL of the registry, as accepted by `nomad-pack registry add` (e.g. `github.com/org/nomad-packs`). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`. Present for Terraform resource identity conventions.
